source_units.text: Write a synopsis of an original play for a program.
Build the piece around these synthetic facts: The fictional play The Unsent Window follows a retired locksmith finding letters addressed to nobody in a wall cavity.
Describe the central conflict over whether to read them, without disclosing the final choice.
The text must contain "The Unsent Window", "a retired locksmith", "letters addressed to nobody" verbatim.
Address this to theatergoers choosing the invented play.
Use at least 60 words and no more than 90 words in total.
Please produce the text now without asking follow-up questions.
